"""由Blender MCP执行的A1样区烘焙：独立UV2、AO与无底色间接光，不替换主场景。"""
import argparse,hashlib,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

ROOT=Path('__PROJECT_ROOT__')
PLAN=json.loads((ROOT/'planning/project.json').read_text())
CFG=PLAN['production']['bakingPilot']
OUT=ROOT/CFG['outputDirectory'];OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

def record(stage,**kwargs):
 payload={'stage':stage,'planningSha256':hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'planning/project.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),**kwargs}
 (OUT/'job.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False))

def prepare():
 # 试验接收面由A1同一规划位置派生，略高于园区底板，避免重叠闪烁。
 g=PLAN['production']['geometryById'][CFG['objectId']];x,y,z=g['position'];dx,dy=CFG['plaza']['centerOffsetM'];w,d=CFG['plaza']['sizeM']
 bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=2,location=(x+dx,y+dy,CFG['plaza']['elevationM']))
 plaza=bpy.context.object;plaza.name='pilot_plaza';plaza.scale=(w/2,d/2,1)
 bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
 plaza.data.materials.append(bpy.data.materials['path'].copy())
 receivers=[bpy.data.objects[n] for n in CFG['receivers']]
 for obj in receivers:
  obj.data=obj.data.copy()
  # 原幕墙UV保持不变，烘焙仅使用独立第二通道。
  if not obj.data.uv_layers:obj.data.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
  uv=obj.data.uv_layers.get(CFG['uvLayer']) or obj.data.uv_layers.new(name=CFG['uvLayer'])
  obj.data.uv_layers.active=uv
  for i,mat in enumerate(obj.data.materials):
   obj.data.materials[i]=mat.copy();obj.data.materials[i].name='pilot_'+mat.name
   bsdf=obj.data.materials[i].node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
   # 间接漫反射的接收材质保持非金属；金属侧板在导出时恢复，不把光照当底色。
  obj['bakeReceiver']=True
 bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
 for obj in receivers:obj.select_set(True)
 bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=receivers[0]
 bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT');bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action='SELECT')
 bpy.ops.uv.smart_project(angle_limit=math.radians(66),island_margin=CFG['marginPx']/CFG['resolution'],area_weight=0.1,correct_aspect=True,scale_to_bounds=False)
 bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
 scene=bpy.context.scene;scene.render.engine='CYCLES';scene.cycles.samples=CFG['samples'];scene.cycles.use_denoising=True
 prefs=bpy.context.preferences.addons['cycles'].preferences
 device='CPU'
 try:
  prefs.compute_device_type='METAL';prefs.get_devices()
  gpu=[v for v in prefs.devices if v.type=='METAL']
  if gpu:
   for v in prefs.devices:v.use=v.type=='METAL'
   scene.cycles.device='GPU';device=', '.join(v.name for v in gpu)
 except Exception:pass
 scene.world.use_nodes=True
 world=scene.world.node_tree.nodes['Background'];world.inputs[0].default_value=(.55,.67,.84,1);world.inputs[1].default_value=.65
 # 烘焙只记录固定几何；动态车辆、人物与水面不留下固定影子。
 excluded=[]
 for obj in bpy.data.objects:
  low=obj.name.lower()
  if low.startswith('vehicle_') or any(word in low for word in ['people','person','water','jet','ripple']):
   obj.hide_render=True;excluded.append(obj.name)
 scene.render.bake.margin=CFG['marginPx'];scene.render.bake.use_clear=True
 scene.render.bake.use_pass_direct=False;scene.render.bake.use_pass_indirect=True;scene.render.bake.use_pass_color=False
 # AO节点限定局部遮蔽距离，避免整栋建筑投射成大块脏黑。
 ao=bpy.data.images.new('pilot_ao',width=CFG['resolution'],height=CFG['resolution']);ao.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color'
 indirect=bpy.data.images.new('pilot_indirect',width=CFG['resolution'],height=CFG['resolution'],float_buffer=True);indirect.colorspace_settings.name='Linear Rec.709'
 for obj in receivers:
  for mat in obj.data.materials:
   nodes=mat.node_tree.nodes
   target=nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');target.name='BakeTarget';target.image=ao;nodes.active=target
   mat['originalMetallic']=nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Metallic'].default_value
 # Cycles AO烘焙采用真实几何；后续通过aoStrength克制接入，避免重复叠加。
 bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(OUT/'pilot-prepared.blend'))
 record('prepared',device=device,receivers=CFG['receivers'],excluded=excluded,uvChannel=CFG['uvChannel'],resolution=CFG['resolution'])


assert not bpy.data.objects.get('pilot_plaza'),'样区已存在，请先加载未烘焙主工程或继续后续操作'
assert all(bpy.data.objects.get(name) for name in CFG['receivers'] if name!='pilot_plaza'),'当前不是A1园区工程'
prepare()
